pain_points: Cables pool on the floor under the desk.
A tangled bundle makes it hard to find the right plug.
Dust collects around loose power strips and adapters.
Kicking the same cable all day loosens the connection.
Cleaning under the desk means moving a nest of wires.
A shared workspace looks messy when cables hang in view.
Drilling into a desk feels like too much for a cable fix.
Power strips slide when they sit directly on the carpet.
A monitor arm and dock add more wires than expected.
Guests see the wiring before they see the workspace.
hooks: Your desk looks clean until someone looks down.

winning_combo.justification: The hook exposes a flaw hidden below a tidy desktop and the pain is visual: the clamp-on tray can be shown filling with cables in one continuous shot.
